about: Every record that changed when the orchestrator's ruling of 2026-11-07 16:47 was applied, for statewide officers and statewide judges: '(a) Where a contest's lines miss counties that voted that day, find its other pieces: the same office and candidates, in counties the first piece lacks. Join them into one record where together they cover every county. (b) Check each joined total against the state's certified total where one is read. The certified count wins (15:16). (c) If it still misses counties: use the state's marked total, if one is read, as the record's count. Otherwise hold it: no p, marked incomplete, and no winner drawn from a partial count. (d) Fix MEDSL's 3 seats per position in WA 2022 from the state's results.' With it: 'One-seat statewide board seats (CO's at-large seat, HI's resident trustees) become statewide officer, by the 16:19 reason. Check every MI Supreme Court contest's seat count against the state's results. ... ND's 8: retype them from the state's results if they are district court seats. List every move.' Reason: 'a shown figure has to be the whole contest's count of record.' Against 679f0d5, whose data/local/ files are main's after #89 (a2a4b0a). pipeline/local_medsl.py statewide_pieces, nd_judgeships, over_ballot, office_type_in; pipeline/intake/wa_sos.py; pipeline/intake/nd_sos.py. Codes: 'A' a new record (North Dakota's 22 district court judgeships, from the Secretary of State's official results); 'G' a record no longer written (MEDSL's 8 pooled North Dakota lines, replaced; and the pieces joined into a contest: Washington 2022's King County lines of the Secretary of State, the Supreme Court's positions 1, 5 and 6 and the advisory votes 39 and 40, Arizona 2024's Corporation Commission and Oregon 2024's Supreme Court position 7); 'T' typed anew, its type before beside it; 'N' p now computed (Washington's three Supreme Court positions, one seat each from the state's export: p 0, unopposed); 'L' p no longer computed (Oregon 2024's Supreme Court positions 1 and 7, held as incomplete); 'R' p not computed before or after, the reason changed (a hold's reason, or the like races of the class its reason names); 'Q' a note's words changed; 'O' other fields (the statewide questions filed as local: listed_statewide.state_total gains its page's url). No p value moved. In the 2024 partisan back-test (data/local/backtest-local-partisan.json) Colorado's at-large regent moves from 'school board' (74 races to 73) to 'statewide officer' (25 to 26); in data/local/calibration-local.json the 2024 test's deviance_by_office_type_before reads 17.58 (17.55 before this step) and its deviance_after 16.86 (16.83), and 'improves' stays true. No record changed in its commit stamp alone. data/local/REPORT.md section 26. Written by worker D3 at 2026-11-07 17:40 UTC.
